'''Cabaniss''': {{legend0|#e27f7f|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Howell Heflin]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Howell Heflin]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Alabama sidebar}} The '''1990 United States Senate election in Alabama''' was held on November 6, 1990. Democratic incumbent [[Howell Heflin]] won re-election to a third term. This was the last time a Democrat was elected to the Class 2 Senate seat in [[Alabama]] until [[2017 United States Senate special election in Alabama|2017]], and the last time overall in which a Democrat was elected to and served a full term as a Democrat in the United States Senate from Alabama. == General election == === Candidates === * [[William J.
